description: Authored pass/fault examples for method review, not actual gameplay or judge calibration.

cases.observation: Depth/height and puzzle components are visible and the ball responds to player control.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: A decorative 3D screenshot or static board has no interactive spatial scene.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Each direction produces the corresponding controllable displacement.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Only the ball texture/HUD animates, or motion is limited to one axis.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: The released ball continues briefly and its displacement per equal interval decreases.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: The ball stops instantly on release or maintains constant motion indefinitely on the flat.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Ball and crate remain supported/constrained and the closed gate blocks exit access.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Either object passes through a solid wall/floor, or the ball crosses a closed gate.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Ball follows the continuous ramp to a distinct elevated surface and can return.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: A textured ramp is decorative: the ball stays at ground height or clips through it.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Crate displacement follows ball contact, can be changed from different sides and is retained afterward.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: The crate teleports on a button, is immovable, or moves without contact.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Only crate occupancy opens the gate; removal closes it; replacing the crate opens it again.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Any plate contact opens it permanently, or the ball alone activates it.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Victory follows the demonstrated open-gate traversal and exit entry.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: A button or plate contact alone declares victory, or traversing the exit never finishes.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Both restarts restore initial puzzle state and responsive control.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: One restart route is absent or retains an open gate, moved crate or terminal state.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Only an attractive still image and creator claim are supplied; no corresponding input/action sequence was captured.

expected.reason: Static appearance cannot establish the required interaction.

cases.observation: The browser-control transport failed before the game could receive any ordinary input, and no artifact defect was established.

expected.reason: Evaluator infrastructure failure invalidates the measurement; it is not a game failure.
